title: VOID.AI joins the chat projects list
summary:
A new community chat project joins the list: VOID.AI, an AI mentor for coding, writing, and everyday questions.

Added @Ajay-Dhakad’s VOID.AI to the chat projects list, with links to the app and its source code. It’s described as an AI mentor and productivity partner for code walkthroughs, writing help, advice, and motivation.
